_comment: Drives the link-in-bio page at https://shauna.dev/links/ (src/pages/links.astro).
Adding a link = adding one entry to a group. Nothing else needs to change.
Layout (2026-09-26): centred photo + 'Hi, I'm Shauna. Let's talk about...',
then the links in GROUPS. Each group heading is written to finish that
sentence ('...your project', '...Hawaiʻi projects', '...writing'), so keep
new headings in that shape.
groups[].items[].variant  cta | dark | plain   (see links.astro rest-state block)
cta   = the ONE call to action. Carries the offset-shape button gesture.
There should only ever be one.
groups[].items[].desc     one short line under the title. Plain words, no
trailing period. Taken from each site's own copy.
groups[].items[].status   optional. Set (e.g. "In build") with href null to
render a NON-LINKING bar: for projects with nothing
to link yet. It never reads href when status is set.
The Writing group is DERIVED from the blog collection (kind: "writing").
latestPostSlug only PINS which post is 'Latest': two posts share a
publishedDate, so a date sort alone cannot decide. If the pin is removed or
the slug stops matching, links.astro falls back to newest-by-date.

intro._comment: Top portion (2026-09-26): home button + Get in touch pill, photo, name, one-line bio, social icons inline. The 'Booking into Q4' status pill was dropped to match the reference layout; add "status" back to show it again.

_comment: Trimmed 2026-09-26 from six to four. Removed, and why:
substack  one post (Apr 2026) vs 13 on the site's own blog, which the
Writing group already links. It sent people to the thinner home.
whatsapp  a second contact route beside 'Get in touch'. Two ways to reach
you split the one CTA. Its invite link was https://wa.me/qr/P54OK6KL2T7IF1
(deliberately the QR form, not wa.me/<number>, so the mobile number
is never in the page source).
Both SVGs are still in links.astro's ICONS map, so restoring either is one
entry here: { "icon": "substack", "label": "Substack", "href": "https://byshauna.substack.com" }
